question: Can the old public identity be restored only when a new fragment is actually confirmed and emitted by the native tracker, avoiding the earlier extra-box admission?
method: Causal canonical public-ID linking. Keep every native track state, association, confidence, class and physical box. Only a never-public native track can receive an absent old canonical identity. The current canonical owner must be a previously public Lost track with the old sole-of-two valid geometry. Preserve native first-stage pairs. Resolve admissible links jointly. On same-frame canonical collision revoke conflicting alias permanently; never drop a native box or rewrite prior output.
scope: First problem only. No arbitration between two existing public working tracks. Historical fit20/evaluate26/val20, not an independent final test. This is a constrained causal form of tracklet linking, not a new invention of spatial matching or offline stitching.
shared_support: Same geometry and common analytic DIS hull>=3 unique reference cells for all added-link arms; same coordinate transform and cost. AGE uses the already fitted cap, RANDOM the already frozen hash gate. Reuse exact ready maps; recover only missing causal sequences.
fit_selection: Use fixed old fit20 thresholds; no retuning on26or20val. After all fit20 arm outcomes are available, select greatest known correct-minus-foreign links; ties fewer foreign, then fewer links, then GEOMETRY,AGE,IMAGE,R1,DIS,FLYVIS. Unknown links never negative. This is a screening rule, not tracker acceptance.
labels: Sparse actual GT anchors only. Old native fragment: consistent known labels within12frames ending at last observation; new native fragment: consistent labels from confirmation through12followingframes. Future anchors only identify a fragment during offline evaluation, never become runtime inputs. Direct-current and delayed-known separated. Unknowns remain unknown.
conditional_gate: Proceed to full historical20val only if selected or GEOMETRY has positive lower95%paired-video CI of known(correct−foreign) links on26. Report foreign links separately; eventual acceptance also requires full wrong-return harm guard.
full_acceptance: Complete physical outputs must equal ready B0 frame by frame. Selected−B0 HOTA lower corrected CI>0; mean AssA/IDF1 nonnegative; IDSw, FP,FN, known wrong returns nonincrease; correct and sustained old-ID returns increase. If any condition fails, first problem remains open. FlyVis-specific benefit additionally requires all matched controls; no biological-core claim from whole-system gain.
limitations: Previously studied data and sequentially proposed alternatives. Current T4/T5 readout may not yet contain the current input after two integration steps; preserve that limitation and do not silently change it. Native box equality does not guarantee exact official CLEAR counts when identity-dependent matching changes.
